acceptanceCriteria: test-validity reports a typed reason when it has no evidence, distinguishing a producer that cannot run on this tuple (unqualified Node/Playwright/OS) from no retained run; callers can tell not to retry.

The Playwright external provider's qualified tuple predicate and spec admit the Darwin arm64 / Node v24.11.x / @playwright/test 1.63.0 bundled headless-shell tuple only after TestQualifiedPlaywrightLive and its negative controls pass on that tuple, or a documented consumer-side qualification path replaces per-patch Corvint releases.
Unqualified tuples still abstain; no passing evidence is projected from an unqualified run.
Spec playwright-external-provider-v0.md records the tuple, the live evidence or NOT_RUN, and the consumer-checkout NOT_OBSERVED note is updated without private adopter detail.
body: GitHub issue 665 (beamfall/corvint#665), 2026-10-07. The Playwright external provider (`corvint-js-test-provider e2e --external-server`) projects passing evidence only on macOS arm64 / Node v22.23.2 / @playwright/test 1.63.0 (PWP-V0-008). An adopter consumer pins Node v24.11.x with Playwright 1.63.0 on Darwin arm64, so no consumer run retains .corvint/test-evidence and the test-validity MCP always returns source=none with 0 tests (13 of 13 calls over 46 sessions per the issue). Asks: qualify the Node 24.11 tuple (live matrix plus negative controls, amend predicate) or define a consumer-side qualification path; meanwhile make test-validity say why it has no evidence. Local host has Node v22.23.3 only (not v22.23.2, not v24). Private adopter detail stays out of the repo; cite the issue.
